title: Day-Ahead Wind Power Forecasting with Open-Source NWP Pipeline
excerpt: Discover an open-source project that delivers a complete pipeline for day-ahead wind power forecasting using NWP data. From preprocessing to model evaluation, it supports multiple farms and integrates machine learning for accurate predictions.
description: Explore an open-source NWP-driven pipeline for day-ahead wind power forecasting. It covers data preprocessing, ML modeling, and evaluation for multiple wind farms.
